title: Supplementary Estimates of Expenditure for the Financial Year 1 April 2015 to 31 March 2016
what_it_is: Supplementary Estimates of Expenditure for the Financial Year 1 April 2015 to 31 March 2016

sections.label: Supplementary Main Estimates expenditure heads
sections.summary: With no amendments, the Speaker proposes taking Heads of Expenditure en bloc, starting with Heads B, I, N, O, V, W and X of the Supplementary Main Estimates.

sentences.speaker: The Chairman
sentences.text: As there are no amendments, I propose to take the Heads of Expenditure en bloc.

sentences.speaker: The Chairman
sentences.text: I will first take Heads B, I, N, O, V, W and X of the Supplementary Main Estimates.
